title: Return-Assessment Reserve on Self-Pay Visit Package Transfers
content:
**Clinical operations guidance.** A Self-Pay Visit Package keeps visits back from a transfer for a return assessment. Visits for a return assessment: where the Appointment Series the package funds is paused or active and the latest package visit used was at least **60 calendar days** ago, **2 visits** are kept back; where it is paused or active and the latest package visit used was at least **30** but fewer than **60** calendar days ago, **1 visit** is kept back; otherwise none. The visits kept back are subtracted from the standing visits.

**Reading the records**

- *Latest package visit used:* the latest appointment date among the attended appointments paid from the package, as its history records them.
- *Days ago:* the calendar days from that appointment date to the day of the transfer.
- *Series status:* that of the Appointment Series linked to the package.

**Day ladder**

| Series status | Days since the latest package visit used | Visits kept back |
|---|---|---|
| paused or active | 60 or more | 2 |
| paused or active | 30 to 59 | 1 |
| paused or active | fewer than 30 | none |
| paused or active | no package visit ever used | none |
| booked, completed, cancelled, or no series | any | none |

**Boundary days (hypothetical, active series):** 60 days — 2 visits; 59 days — 1 visit; 30 days — 1 visit; 29 days — none.
